podcast.body: This 1981 solo release by Queen drummer Roger Taylor was found as a poster on the wall at the Foo Fighters' 606 Studios. It was particularly notable as Taylor Hawkins expressed immense admiration for Roger Taylor, calling him his "favorite drummer ever." "It was a 1981 release entitled Fun in Space."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
